specification.objective: Integrate origin/main commit 1024189266d6cdbcb70a231e87d6c1a366e1147a into PR #123 head f1591b10e4ce5d1d988f45b120a90d1539b67fd9 while preserving the PR navigation behavior and canonical historical evidence.

requirements.statement: The merged frontend shell retains PR #123 workspace routing, navigation, and login-to-workspace behavior while incorporating upstream WorkspaceSkeleton and WorkspaceSkeletonRegion loading behavior.
All four docs/validation/issue-119 PNG snapshots and the versioned #123 v1/v2 contracts remain byte-identical to the clean PR-head baseline.
The same configured functional characterization passes on the clean baseline and integrated target; the target also passes every enabled Project Policy command gate.
No visual snapshot or application layout is changed to mask the outstanding canonical Ubuntu golden difference.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The integrated shell composes the PR navigation/session flow with the upstream skeleton interfaces and focused navigation/skeleton tests pass.
SHA-256 comparisons against the locked PR-head tree confirm the four issue-119 PNG files and v1/v2 contract files are byte-identical.
The exact behavior command passes against both the locked baseline and integrated target; all effective command gates in .polis/policy.json pass on target.
The canonical snapshots and production layout have no changes in the integration diff; the unresolved image mismatch remains subject to actual/expected/diff review.

invariants.statement: Keep the four issue-119 PNG snapshots and #123 v1/v2 contract/proof history byte-identical; add only the new versioned v3 contract.
Preserve authentication/session revocation, API contracts, and navigation routes already present at the locked PR baseline.
Retain all upstream #121 changes and their regression tests; do not resolve the conflict by restoring APIs removed upstream.

forbidden_states.statement: Any of the four issue-119 PNGs or historical #123 v1/v2 contracts are rewritten or omitted.
The merge drops PR navigation/session behavior or the upstream skeleton behavior/tests.
Application layout or snapshots are modified to conceal the failing canonical Ubuntu comparison.

inputs.statement: Clean PR baseline f1591b10e4ce5d1d988f45b120a90d1539b67fd9 and fetched origin/main 1024189266d6cdbcb70a231e87d6c1a366e1147a.
Existing #123 v1/v2 locks, tests and four canonical issue-119 snapshots.

outputs.statement: A conflict-resolved local integration commit and immutable #123 v3 POLIS contract with validation evidence.

failure_semantics.statement: A failed characterization, changed historical artifact hash, omitted upstream behavior, or failed effective command gate blocks publication.
